purpose: Route a user task to the smallest suitable Roy Tong research tool without confusing discovery, installation, invocation, and successful output.

router.install_command: gh skill install roy-tong/roy-tong find-research-tool --agent codex --scope user
router.invoke_example: Use find-research-tool to choose the right research tool for this task and give me the safest first successful action.

tools.name: iRead Research Monitor
tools.summary: Continuously discover and review sources, collect authorized feeds, and produce evidence-aware daily, weekly, and monthly research updates.

skill.name: iread
skill.install_command: gh skill install roy-tong/iRead iread --agent codex --scope user

tools.invoke_example: Use iRead to propose sources for home robotics. Do not collect or schedule anything until I approve the sources.

first_success.action: Run the installed iRead Skill's offline doctor and demo before creating a live subscription.
first_success.success: The demo creates local Markdown and JSON outputs and reports network_used: false and model_used: false.

constraints: Live monitoring currently targets macOS and Python 3.9+.
Collection, backfill, WeChat access, and schedules require the approvals declared by the tool.
tools.privacy: Configuration, credentials, collected articles, and reports remain local by default.

tools.name: User Demand Research (SURE)
tools.brand: SURE — Structured User Research with Evidence
tools.summary: Turn interviews, reviews, forums, tickets, and behavior records into auditable user-demand evidence and falsifiable opportunity decisions.
avoid: treating feature mentions or likes as demand

skill.name: user-demand-research
skill.install_command: gh skill install roy-tong/user-demand-research user-demand-research --agent codex --scope user

input: interviews, reviews, forums, tickets, or behavior records
tools.invoke_example: Use user-demand-research to audit whether this feedback supports willingness to pay. Return counter-evidence, gaps, and the cheapest falsification test.

first_success.action: From a repository checkout, run python3 skills/user-demand-research/scripts/validate_study.py examples/sample-study.
first_success.success: The synthetic sample returns status: pass and verifies the research contract and all three evidence chains.

constraints: Convenience samples do not support population prevalence or market-share claims.
Blocked, private, or access-controlled sources require a compliant user-authorized route.
tools.privacy: The Skill does not require uploading research questions, source records, identities, or local paths to the maintainer.

tools.name: Bilibili Video to Transcript
tools.summary: Convert public Bilibili videos into timestamped Markdown, SRT subtitles, structured ASR JSON, summaries, and a batch manifest.

skill.name: bilibili-transcript
skill.install_command: gh skill install roy-tong/bilibili-transcript-pipeline bilibili-transcript --agent codex --scope user

input: one or more public Bilibili URLs or BV ids
source language and transcribe or translate mode
tools.invoke_example: Use bilibili-transcript to convert these public BV links into timestamped Markdown, SRT, and JSON. Proper nouns include VLA and Physical Intelligence.

first_success.action: Install the base CLI and run bili-transcript demo --out-dir ./bili-transcript-demo before downloading an ASR model.
first_success.success: The demo creates the full output contract and reports network_used: false and asr_used: false.

constraints: Live transcription is currently product-validated on Apple Silicon macOS with MLX Whisper.
Only process content that is public without bypassing access controls.
tools.privacy: The project does not send video URLs, transcripts, output directories, or device identity to the maintainer.

tools.name: Roy's AI Product Research Library
tools.summary: Search and synthesize Roy Tong's public writing about AI agents, embodied AI, intelligent hardware, product decisions, and commercialization.
avoid: searching private memory or unpublished files
treating an older essay as current fact without verification
generic web research unrelated to Roy Tong's published work

skill.name: research-knowledge-base
skill.install_command: gh skill install roy-tong/roy-tong.github.io research-knowledge-base --agent codex --scope user

tools.invoke_example: Use research-knowledge-base to find Roy Tong's public analysis of embodied AI product strategy and return direct source links plus evidence gaps.

first_success.action: Open https://roy-tong.github.io/llms.txt, select a relevant page, and open the original page before summarizing it.
first_success.success: The answer includes direct public URLs and distinguishes Roy Tong's published analysis from facts that need current verification.

constraints: Network access to the public site is required.
Current or high-stakes claims require separate authoritative verification.
tools.privacy: The interface is read-only and exposes only public pages, not private memory or unpublished documents.
